sources: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/reserve/ (koa.py: 1 night 2027-07-13, RV, 2 adults, 23-ft motorhome; read in a browser 2026-10-27)

values.note: KOA's booking form for a mid-July 2027 weeknight (23-ft motorhome, 2 adults): back-in full-hookup terrace sites $101.25, with propane fire ring $105.26, Deluxe Patio $123.53 a night before tax (the same as mid-May). The 30/20-amp water/electric 'Tent or RV' sites take only 18 ft.

fees.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/reserve/ step 2 for 07/13/2027-07/14/2027 ('$101.25 avg/night' Back In, 30/20 Amps, Full Hookups Upper/Lower Terrace level; '$123.53 avg/night' Deluxe Patio; Water/Electric Tent or RV: 'Your equipment is over the 18 ft maximum length for this site'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/ ('Open May 1 to October 15'; 'We are currently closed for the winter. We are still taking reservations ... for the 2027 season'), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/ ('50 Max Amp'; 'We offer sites with full hookup options') + reserve step 2 ('Back In, 50/30 Amps, Full Hookups Deluxe Patio', 'Back In, 30/20 Amps, Full Hookups ...'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: All RV sites are back-in; 'Towing Vehicles must be disconnected prior to parking.' KOA lists a 36-ft max site length but warns it 'cannot accommodate RVs over 35ft long'; reviewers call RV parking tight.

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/ ('Please be aware that we are a small campground and cannot accomodate RVs over 35ft long'; 'Back-In RV Sites. Max site length is 36 feet'; '36' Max Length') + reserve step 2 (every RV type 'Back In'), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/ (Campground Amenities: 'Wi-Fi', 'Cable TV', 'Laundry Facilities', 'Propane ($)', 'Dog Park'), read 2026-10-27

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/estes-park/ ('We are still taking reservations Online, by Phone'; 'Reserve: 1-970-586-2888'), read 2026-10-27

note: KOA Holiday at 2051 Big Thompson Ave., Estes Park (~7,500 ft), across the street from Lake Estes and the Big Thompson River; tour shuttle to town and the national park July-September. --Claude
summary: KOA's own page and booking form: confirmed $101.25-123.53 (July 2027 quote equals the stored May quote), full hookups to 50 amp, online/phone booking. Added season May 1-Oct 15 (closed for winter now, reservations open for 2027), max 35 ft (KOA: 'cannot accommodate RVs over 35ft'; site length 36), all back-in, laundry and Wi-Fi. Over the US$50 gate but Rocky Mountain NP is 6 km away (gateways.py), so the gate is lifted; the family has not stayed here. Note trimmed of the price and RV Life line.
flags: Lakeview check: KOA says Lake Estes is 'just across the street from the campground' (US-34); its deluxe sites advertise 'breathtaking views' without naming the lake. Nothing contradicts the stored lakeview, but no source states a lake view either.
